$comment: One-line art brief per base card id: what the card's image shows. `cast` names a mech from cardArtStyle.json `casts` when a specific mech appears. Seeded from the crop notes in docs/card-art-plates.md; cards missing here get a DRAFT subject from their name and rules text.

neutral_basic_strike.subject: A single purple electric gauntlet punching toward the viewer, impact flash at the knuckles
